content.comment_body: Hello everyone. I am unsure about how to read data from an encoder and would appreciate assistance, as I have not done this before. Thank you.

Hi, you can connect the encoder signals to any digital input of the [product_name] and use an up/down counter to register the pulses. For DC versions, a frequency up to 5kHz is supported. Hope this information is useful.
